name: Rural India and Planning for Development
description: The indian village in imagination and reality; understanding rurality beyond geography; emerging rural aspirations and transformations; development and governmentality; theories and perspectives on development; understanding rural development plans, schemes and programs, decentralization of power and panchayati raj institutions; Green revolution and its impacts; rural problems; development-induced displacements and exclusion in development practice; issues of social and environmental justice; rural health, social determinant of health; traditional, indigenous, modern rural healthcare systems; participatory development for rural India; participatory learning and action; rural grassroots initiatives and case studies; academic/corporate social responsibility; appropriate technology and innovation for rural development; transforming villages and higher education through unnat bharat abhiyan.
